messages:
ravi: Quick note — proposing a compact-offload policy for streaming large LLM outputs. Capturing constraints so we can decide how aggressive offload should be.

zoe: Summary?

ravi: Edge should stream tokens normally but, beyond a per-request inline threshold, switch to compact-offload: small metadata frames + chunk references persisted to object-store. Compared to full sideloading we keep chunk metadata compact and avoid issuing presigned URLs to clients unless necessary.

kim: Why compact vs full sideload?

ravi: Compact reduces attack surface (no client-facing URLs), reduces CDN churn, and centralizes fetch logic to edge proxies. Tradeoff: adds extra hop when clients need full payload (edge must proxy chunk fetch).

zoe: How do retries behave? If upstream dies mid-stream we want deterministic resume.

ravi: Resume token contains upstream-digest, prompt-hash, model-version, and last-offset. Edge keeps chunk refs in small metadata store; on resume, edge replays stored chunks and optionally resumes upstream if digest matches. If digest mismatches, return 410 + explanation.

kim: Backpressure and egress limits?

ravi: Admission control knobs: inline_threshold=128KB, offload_after=256KB, max_compact_offloads_per_tenant=4, node_global_compact_limit=128, max_bytes_per_tenant_per_hour. When limits exceeded return 429 with X-Edge-Reason: offload-cap.

infra-bot: Recommend verifying chunk integrity with content-hash and storing metadata with tenant-scoped keys. Also emit metrics: offload.count, offload.bytes, resume.success, resume.fail.

devx: SDK impact? clients expect same API?

ravi: Yes — streaming frames unchanged early; when compact-offload kicks in we send a small control frame: {"type":"offload.start","resume_token":"rtk...","meta_url":"/v1/chunks/rtk"}. Clients using SDKs will call edge to fetch chunk list or request resume. We’ll provide helper that retries transparently.

zoe: Security: no presigned URLs leaked, but ensure chunk fetch endpoints require auth and short TTL. Also scrub chunk refs from logs.

kim: Observability: record per-request partial-ack windows, chunk-persist-latency, and offload-induced-latency added to tail SLOs.

ravi: Rollout plan: P1 internal-only with compact-offload disabled by default and opt-in header X-Compact-Offload: true. P2 canary for low-traffic tenants with telemetry. P3 GA with SDK helpers and Dedicated config knobs.

devx: Action items: devx -> draft SDK helper spec (this sprint). infra -> small metadata store + hash-verify (1w). kim -> perf spike for proxy fetch (2w). ravi -> update RFC with error matrix and sequence diagram (EOD).

zoe: +1. Also propose a small TTL for resume tokens (e.g., 10m) to bound storage.

ravi: Agreed. I'll include token TTL and tenant quotas in the RFC update. Thanks folks.
